# Support

tidyshare is community maintained and has no commercial support commitment.

Use [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/ioplane/tidyshare/discussions)
for usage and design questions. Use the issue forms for reproducible bugs,
documentation defects and feature proposals. Vulnerabilities follow the
private process in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## Include with a support request

- the output of `tidyshare version`;
- Linux distribution, kernel and the filesystem type of the scanned tree;
- the command line, with private paths redacted;
- the complete error message;
- minimal reproduction steps on a disposable directory.

Do not attach file listings, reports or archives from production storage.

## Scope

Supported: the documented Linux release binaries, the CLI, the report formats
and the `apply` safety behavior. Outside support: recovery of data after a
manual deletion, filesystem tuning, and the content of third-party YARA rule
sets.
